fusions.name: Slipped Leash
fusions.desc: Slips a hound of knotted hair off its leash at a target up to 8 tiles away. It bites for 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Worry the Wound
fusions.desc: Catches a target carrying one of your afflictions by the strand tied to it and shakes it, using that affliction up. It deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cure From the Biter
fusions.desc: Presses a hair from what bit you into the wound. It restores 14 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Tether Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound on a leash of your own hair. It fights beside you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, and anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
